name: Forest fires in Sudan, South Sudan
summary: Between 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-18, HH backscatter here changed by +2.2 dB and HV by +2.9 dB (mean within 500 m). Across the mapped area, 3% got at least 3 dB weaker and 56% at least 3 dB stronger.
method: NISAR L2 GCOV (terrain-corrected gamma-naught), frequency A, 2 passes on track 086-A-006-DHDH. Time series: mean linear power within 500 m of the point, in dB. Change map: HH after minus before, 5×5 mean filter against speckle, changes under 1.5 dB not drawn; 'after' is the pass that differs most from the first in HH (this track does not have a pass on both sides of the event of 2026-11-16 yet).
